attributes.description: Overview of Trellix ePO On-Prem audit activity.

params.markdown:
#### Overview

This dashboard provides visibility into Trellix ePO On-Prem audit log activity. It highlights administrative actions, system operations, and user behavior across the environment. The dashboard helps security teams, compliance officers, and system administrators monitor audit activity, identify policy changes, track user actions, and detect anomalies in the ePO system.

Visualizations include total events and active users metrics, events breakdown by action type and priority level, success vs. failure rate analysis, top users by activity, and audit event trends over time. Interactive controls allow filtering by date range, user, action type, and outcome for focused analysis and troubleshooting of audit events.
